checks: Browser cloud requests use the anon credential
Cloud rows render and retain one article per event and URL
Cloud origin and selection mode are preserved
Cloud content renders as the inline article body
Missing view falls back to articles with body and event aliases
Cloud outage falls back to local JSON

Cloud and JSON failure retain cached articles
